take: Houthi plans to seize land along the Yemeni coast in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait threaten to tighten control of a chokepoint that, alongside the closed Strait of Hormuz, is rerouting global crude and product flows and keeping the risk premium bid. Washington's emergency waiver easing gasoline rules, with US pump prices above $4 a gallon, underscores the political sensitivity of refined product inflation and supports cracks even as crude supply disruption persists. China's seaborne imports of Russian crude are rising as it replaces missing Iranian barrels, squeezing India out of that trade and shifting dirty tanker tonne-mile demand eastward. The US Gulf Coast waterborne shipments to the West Coast more than quadrupled year-on-year in April and May after a waiver, a flow that competes with Panama Canal transits and supports clean product freight. Watch for further UKMTO advisories after the tanker hijacking 136 nautical miles east of Al Mukalla, as any escalation in the Gulf of Aden will hit Suezmax and product tanker rates immediately.

items.title: Longer wells boost Permian crude oil and natural gas production
items.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.

items.title: Waterborne shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast increased in April and May
items.summary: Waterborne shipments of crude oil and petroleum products from the U.S. Gulf Coast (PADD 3) to the West Coast (PADD 5) more than quadrupled year-on-year in April and May following a waiver that permitted a broader group of ships to travel between U.S. ports. Shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast to the East Coast (PADD 1) also increased.
